# Third-party source files

Selected original materials are preserved byte-for-byte from these pinned MIT-licensed projects:

- phuryn/pm-skills — Copyright (c) 2026 Pawel Huryn. Seven discovery skills.
- alirezarezvani/claude-skills — Copyright (c) 2025 Alireza Rezvani. Product discovery method, reference and assumption mapper.
- bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD — Copyright (c) 2025 BMad Code, LLC and contributors. Brainstorming technique data.

Each source has its full LICENSE beside the copied files. Commit IDs, original paths and SHA-256 are in source-manifest.json. Original SKILL.md files are named METHOD.md locally so they remain internal reference materials rather than parallel skill entrypoints. Their contents are unchanged.

The Chinese workflow in references/discovery-and-brainstorming.md is an adaptation for the existing PRODUCT role. The safe JSON wrapper in scripts/prioritize_assumptions.py calls the original assumption mapper and adds input validation and evidence labels. Upstream marketing claims, commands and approval/delegation defaults are not adopted as project instructions. No upstream startup hooks or servers are enabled. Other research candidates are not included.
